visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tempting close-up of three golden-brown, breaded creamy crab croquettes resting on a dark blue plate with a garnish of shredded white cabbage. A pair of black chopsticks gently pulls one croquette apart, revealing a steaming, creamy white interior flecked with red crab meat. (2) Transition to the cooking process: a pair of hands wearing clear plastic gloves uses a metal spoon to place a block of yellow unsalted butter into a black non-stick pan over a wooden tabletop. The butter melts into a bubbling liquid. (3) Diced white onions are poured from a small glass bowl into the pan and stirred with a wooden spatula until they become translucent and soft under warm indoor lighting. (4) Minced garlic is added to the onions. The chef sprinkles in granulated sugar, salt, and black pepper from small containers, stirring constantly to integrate the flavors into the softened vegetables. (5) High-gluten flour is added to the pan, and the chef uses the spatula to cook out the raw flour taste, turning the mixture into a thick, clumpy paste. (6) Fresh milk is poured from a glass pitcher into the pan in stages. The mixture is stirred until it transforms into a smooth, thick, and velvety white béchamel sauce that begins to bubble slightly. (7) Shredded red-and-white crab meat and additional minced garlic are added to the thick sauce and folded in with the wooden spatula. (8) The mixture is cooled and then scooped into the chef's gloved hands, where it is shaped into smooth, oval-shaped patties. (9) Each patty is sequentially dredged in a plate of white flour, dipped into a shallow bowl of yellow egg wash, and finally coated thoroughly in a bowl of coarse white breadcrumbs. (10) The breaded patties are carefully lowered into a pan of hot, shimmering oil. They deep-fry until the exterior turns a uniform, vibrant golden-brown color with a crunchy texture. (11) A mesh strainer is used to lift the hot croquettes out of the oil. (12) In a small glass bowl, the chef mixes a spoonful of white mayonnaise with a splash of orange sweet chili sauce using a metal spoon to create a dipping sauce. (13) The video concludes with the finished croquettes arranged attractively, ready to be served.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, medium-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM. A cheerful male narrator introduces the dish with high energy. The faint, low-frequency sound of melting butter sizzling in a pan is heard in the background. (2) A metallic 'clink' sound occurs as a spoon drops ingredients. The narrator explains the onion cooking process with clear articulation and a friendly tone. (3) A consistent wooden scraping sound rhythmicly repeats as the chef stirs the roux. The BGM remains steady with a light percussion beat. (4) A distinct liquid 'glug' and splash sound is audible as milk is poured into the pan. The narrator's pitch rises slightly as he describes the sauce thickening. (5) Soft rustling sounds of plastic gloves and the dry crunch of breadcrumbs are heard as the croquettes are shaped and coated. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to the frying stage, followed by the loud, high-frequency white-noise sizzle of deep-frying oil bubbling vigorously. (7) A light metallic clink of a spoon hitting a glass bowl accompanies the sauce-making step. The narration concludes with an enthusiastic summary as the BGM swells slightly before a hard cut to silence.
